column1: # Fixture patch for scripts/patch_gtf_gene_ids.py, written against
# That fixture has one offender per failure direction of
# bin/check_gtf_hla_gene_ids.py, and this patch fixes each with a different
# action, so both paths of the script are exercised:
#   duplicated_gene_name  HLA-A is on two gene_ids -> rename the redundant one
#   duplicated_gene_id    ENSG_MIC_SHARED carries both MICA and MICB, an
#                         annotation artifact with no salvageable single name
#                         -> remove it, and with it both of its rows
# Patching mhc_duplicate.gtf with this file makes the check exit 0. ENSG_HLA_A
# (2 rows), ENSG_HLA_B and ENSG_GENE_X are not listed and must come through
